interpretation.planned: validate the saved benchmark evidence with the Iteration 16 validators, including the per-stage evidence binding, the exact provider-backed billing join and the independently verifiable Modal provenance evidence
interpretation.attempted: per-target stage/evidence binding, Modal provenance, App ID cross-check, replay envelope, EVM provenance and sentinel checks plus the billing reconciliation
interpretation.executed: the validators were executed against the artifacts stored on disk
interpretation.observed: the saved run predates the Iteration 16 fix; the artifacts that carry no per-stage evidence are reported as FAILED, and the billing attribution itself reconciles exactly
interpretation.reported: PASSED means every checked artifact satisfies the Iteration 16 validators; FAILED means at least one artifact does not. The report never claims more than the artifacts prove, and no Modal runtime validation is claimed.
interpretation.producer_rehearsal: the producer path was rehearsed offline against faithful worker responses; the rehearsal never claims a Modal runtime validation
